mapping.summary: AI layer over BC and other systems: risk alerts, agents, executive cockpit.
claims: Combines data from ERP, WMS, banks, tax services, email and files
Flags late-payment risk, slow stock, falling margins and customers ordering less every day
AI agents handle triage, summaries, collection reminders and briefings
Agent actions are logged and those above a threshold need human approval
Executive cockpit with revenue, margin, cash and collections, also in a mobile app
Production connectors for Business Central and NAV, Microsoft 365 and Teams
Supports e-invoicing and Open Banking (PSD2) connections
Hosted on Azure in the EU in a dedicated environment per customer
Single sign-on with Entra ID; Google also supported
AI processing can be kept to EU providers and regions
Essential plan: up to 5 users, from EUR 490 per month plus implementation
Professional plan: up to 15 users, from EUR 990 per month plus implementation
